scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Power Subsidy (PS)
other_conditions: The business/organization must belong to the manufacturing sector.
Production must have started on or after 1 April 2019.
The enterprise can be in the private, cooperative, joint sector, or be owned/managed by the State Government or Industrial SHGs.
The Date of Commencement of Commercial Production (DOCCP) must fall between 1 April 2020 and 31 March 2025.
The first application must be submitted within 12 months from the DOCCP or within 12 months from the notification of Banglashree, whichever is later.
benefits_summary: Provides a power subsidy of ₹1.00 / kWh in Zones A & B or ₹1.50 / kWh in Zones C, D & E for up to five years, with annual caps of ₹10 lakh for micro, ₹20 lakh for small and ₹30 lakh for medium enterprises.
